text:
maria_cs: Heads up — ticket #CS-4821 from ACME. They say trial credits expired mid-loadtest and started getting 402s. Customer asked for a reinstatement or short extension so their integration can finish.

ben_billing: thanks — can you paste account_id and exact timestamps for the loadtest? also how many tokens did they expect to have left?

maria_cs: account_id: acct_8a3f
loadtest window: 2026-03-15 09:00 - 09:45 UTC
customer reported ~15k tokens left before failures. See error payload below they pasted: 
```json
POST /v1/outputs
{
  "error": {
    "type": "insufficient_credits",
    "message": "Trial credits exhausted",
    "code": 402
  }
}
```

jordan_ops: I pulled platform logs for acct_8a3f — credits dropped to 0 at 2026-03-15T09:12:27Z after a burst. I also see a billing webhook retry failure earlier that morning (~2026-03-15T06:02Z) where our gateway didn't process a top-up event.

ben_billing: policy reminder: trials auto-expire at their end date. We make exceptions if platform errors prevented the customer from using credits. Is there evidence we missed a charge or webhook processing?

maria_cs: customer claims identical load profile yesterday and didn't exhaust then. They attached their loadtest logs showing same request rate. Requesting either a 7-day extension or 20k token reinstatement to complete verification.

ben_billing: ok — we can do a one-time manual grant for this kind of platform failure. Proposal: grant 20,000 tokens, expires +7 days. Need manager sign-off and an audit note: 'manual grant after billing webhook retry failure prevented auto-topup'. Who will own audit note?

jordan_ops: I'll take the postmortem ownership and confirm webhook failure root cause. This should be a one-off; not a recurring credit.

support_bot: Grant request logged: GRANT-8932. Owner: ben_billing. Status: pending_approval.

maria_cs: customer is mid-demo and asking for an immediate fix — can we push the grant ASAP?

ben_billing: approved by billing manager (cc: @sasha). Creating manual grant now.

ben_billing: Done — issued 20000 tokens to acct_8a3f. grant_id: GRANT-8932. Expires: 2026-03-22T23:59:59Z. Reason: "manual reinstatement after billing webhook retry failure". Please confirm with customer.

maria_cs: Confirmed with customer: tests resumed and no further 402s observed. They replied :relieved: and asked for the audit note when available. I've updated ticket #CS-4821 with grant details and the grant_id.

jordan_ops: I'll follow up with infra oncall and produce a short postmortem about the webhook retry logic. Tagging infra-oncall for review: @infra-oncall

ben_billing: :thumbsup: I'll add the manual grant to the billing ledger and mark it as an exception. Closing internal escalation unless anything else pops up.

support_bot: GRANT-8932 -> completed
